parameters.name: userID
parameters.description: ID of the user. `me` is also accepted for the signed-in user

current.description: The present password, required when you change your own password, ignored for another user

200.description: true when the password was changed

403.description: Not allowed: API tokens are refused here, use a signed-in session. The answer is an error with the message `API tokens cannot manage users`.

description:
Sets a password. For your own account `current` (the present password) is required and the answer sets a fresh session cookie; an administrator sets another user's password without it. Every other session of that user ends; API tokens keep working.

Needs: a signed-in session as that user or as an administrator (API tokens are refused)
